name: heptatrader-agent-os
description: Expose HeptaTrader's identity-bound OS trading tools through a local MCP bridge.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex or OpenClaw to the local HeptaTrader Tool Gateway. The plugin holds no broker credentials and all reads and mutations remain authorized by the Gateway and Execution Service.
defaultPrompt: Inspect HeptaTrader health, account, positions, orders, and risk before taking any action.
Use only tools exposed by this session; never infer PAPER or LIVE authority.
